# TP-Link Deco XE75 — AXE5400 Tri-Band Mesh Wi-Fi 6E System

**Category:** Networking (Mesh Wi-Fi System)
**MSRP:** $299.99 (2-pack)

## Tech Specs

| Spec | Detail |
|---|---|
| Wi-Fi Standard | Wi-Fi 6E (802.11ax 6 GHz / 802.11ax/ac/n/a 5 GHz / 802.11ax/n/b/g 2.4 GHz) |
| Wi-Fi Speeds | AXE5400 total — 6 GHz: 2402 Mbps (HE160), 5 GHz: 2402 Mbps (HE160), 2.4 GHz: 574 Mbps |
| Coverage | Up to 7,200 ft² (3-pack), 5,500 ft² (2-pack), 2,900 ft² (1-pack) |
| Device Capacity | Up to 200 devices |
| Antennas | 4× high-gain internal antennas per unit |
| MIMO / Multi-user | 2×2 MU-MIMO, OFDMA, 6 streams |
| Mesh Backhaul | TP-Link Mesh Technology (wireless, incl. 6 GHz), optional Ethernet backhaul, AI-Driven Mesh |
| Working Modes | Router Mode, Access Point Mode |
| Ethernet Ports | 3× Gigabit ports per unit (WAN/LAN auto-sensing) |
| Security | SPI Firewall, Access Control, WPA-Personal/WPA2-Personal/WPA3-Personal, HomeShield (IoT protection, malicious site blocker, IPS, DDoS prevention) |
| VPN | OpenVPN, PPTP, L2TP/IPSec (server and client) |
| Guest Networks | 1× per band (6 GHz, 5 GHz, 2.4 GHz) |
| Management | Deco App, TP-Link ID, OTA firmware updates, DDNS |
| Dimensions (per unit) | 4.1 × 4.1 × 6.7 in (105 × 105 × 169 mm) |
| Certifications | CE, FCC, RoHS |
| Operating Temp | 0°C–40°C (32°F–104°F) |

## Notable Features
- Tri-band Wi-Fi 6E with a dedicated 6 GHz band that can be used for backhaul, reducing congestion for connected devices
- AI-Driven Mesh automatically learns the network environment for optimal signal routing between units
- HomeShield security suite adds real-time IoT protection, parental controls, and network scanning (basic tier free, Pro tier subscription)
- Backward-compatible with all prior Wi-Fi generations and works with any ISP/modem
- Named Engadget's pick for best mesh Wi-Fi system for most people (2023)
